name: klsh
description: Minimal text-based pipeline framework for browser environment

scripts.test: bash -c 'set -o pipefail && npm run build 2>&1 | cat' && bash -c 'set -o pipefail && mocha --recursive tests 2>&1 | cat'
scripts.parse: node build.js && exec $(command -v rlwrap >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo rlwrap) node parse.js
scripts.start: node build.js && command -v rlwrap >/dev/null && rlwrap node klsh.js || node klsh.js
